props.name: items
props.description: Elements to scroll. Each is repeated to fill the track.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause the scrolling while the pointer is over the marquee.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the left and right edges.

props.name: repeat
props.description: How many times the items repeat inside one half of the track. Raise it if your items are narrower than the container.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
